blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.

Transfer to José María Córdova International Airport and flight to Cartagena. The flight is not included in the price.

On arrival, meet at Rafael Núñez International Airport and transfer to the hotel.

Then take a private sightseeing tour in an air-conditioned vehicle.

The route includes panoramic views of the Bay of Cartagena, the Muelle de los Pegasos, the Clock Tower and the Manga neighbourhood, where Moorish and Republican architecture survives.

Visit Castillo de San Felipe de Barajas, then walk through the historic centre within the city walls.

There will be stops to shop for handicrafts and walk through the old streets and squares. You will also see the Church of San Pedro Claver and the Santo Domingo bastion.

Return to the hotel.

**Duration:** approximately 4 hours.  
**Available:** daily.

**Included:** a professional English-speaking guide, private transport and entrance fees to the listed sites.
